identity.description: Amar Singh Higher Secondary School is a leading educational institution located in Amargadhi Municipality of Dadeldhura district. It plays a pivotal role in providing accessible and quality education to students from diverse backgrounds in the Sudurpashchim Province. The school offers programs from primary levels up to 10+2 higher secondary education across multiple streams.
